# Emily & Phil Gordon

- [Emily](../character/emily.md) — Relative of — [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) — father's second cousin · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Philippa writes a long letter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) describing her summer spent at Cousin Emily's boarding house. She humorously introduces the eccentric fellow boarders and relates how she met [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), a divinity student. Though she tries to deny her feelings because he is ugly and serious, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) admits by the end of her letter that she has fallen in love with him.
